text: Taking the egg with `take egg` increased the score from 0 to 5.

From Behind House, `open window` was required before `enter window`; entering the Kitchen with `enter window` gained 10 points (score 0 to 10 in this run, or 5 to 15 when the egg had already been scored).

Descending through the opened trap door with `down` increased the score by 25 points (10 to 35 here; 15 to 40 in an earlier run). Take the lantern and turn it on first, because turning it on without carrying it left the cellar pitch black.
Taking the painting with `take painting` increased the score by 4 points (35 to 39 here; 40 to 44 in an earlier run).

The Troll Room's troll blocks progress when you have no weapon: `kill troll with sword` failed because you did not have a sword, and `take sword` said none was visible. In this run, entering the room did not itself change the score or end the game.
The trap door crashed shut and was barred from above when you descended, leaving no demonstrated way back up; this followed from entering the cellar without first securing a way to reopen it.

In the Clearing, the first `move leaves` revealed a grating, but `open grating` said it was locked. Taking the leaves did not help (`move leaves` failed), and after dropping them, moving the pile revealed nothing; no key or other unlocking method was found.

Opening the trophy case in the Living Room reveals a battery-powered lantern; `take lantern` and `turn on lantern` successfully put a lit lantern in inventory. The wooden door to the west still appeared nailed shut.
In the Kitchen, opening the brown sack revealed lunch and garlic; both were taken and then dropped without being used. The bottle was taken and opened, but its water was never used.
The dark staircase led into pitch darkness and warned that a grue might eat you; do not proceed there without a demonstrated light source.
The dark chimney led down and to the east, but it was never entered or investigated.
The room has passages east and south and a hole west, but none was explored because the troll blocked progress.
The death and 10-point score loss resulted from dropping the lantern in the Studio and then entering Gallery's dark west passage without a light; a grue devoured you.
In the Studio, `climb chimney` repeatedly failed while carrying items; dropping the painting, lantern, lunch, paper, and sandwich and retrying still did not make it climbable.

The death was caused by descending without taking the lantern: `turn on lantern` in the Living Room did not put it in inventory, and the cellar remained pitch black despite the sword's faint glow; going east then led to the grue.
In the Living Room, `take lantern` followed by `turn on lantern` successfully put a lit lantern in inventory; do this before descending through the trap door.
The thief wounded you after you carried the painting into the Studio and dropped it while he was present; no weapon or action against the thief was used beforehand.
A person guarding a large bag was present in the Cellar, but the bag was never taken or the person confronted; attempts to obtain a sword found no sword.
A hot pepper sandwich appeared in the Studio and was taken, then dropped without being eaten or otherwise used.
The game ended by giving up in the Studio at score 44 after taking and reading the paper; no further exit or action was attempted, and the Gallery's west exit had not been explored.
The Gallery description says the vandals left through either the north or west exits; in this run only the north exit to the Studio was tried, so the west exit remained unexplored.
The rainbow and river looked promising, but `examine rainbow` said there was nothing special; `swim`, `swim east`, and `enter rainbow` produced no crossing or other progress.

The run's setback came from skipping the Living Room trophy case and its lantern, then using `up` from the Kitchen; this entered a pitch-black staircase where a grue was likely to eat you, and you gave up without attempting the west passage.
The west passage from the Kitchen, leading toward the Living Room, was never explored in this run; investigating it and the trophy case remained promising.

Progress was blocked because you entered without a weapon: `kill troll with sword` said you did not have one, and `take sword` said no sword was visible. No weapon had been obtained earlier, and the troll's east, south, and west routes were not explored.
The Studio's open south door was left unexplored because you gave up immediately after reading the paper.
